mainEntity.name: What is an AI test creator?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI test creator is a smart tool that helps you generate quizzes or exams in seconds using artificial intelligence. Just type a topic, and it builds questions, answers, and scoring for you—no manual work needed.

mainEntity.name: How does an AI test generator work?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI testing in high schools saves time, boosts engagement, and helps teachers focus on teaching. AI can generate tests, grade answers, and track student performance instantly.

mainEntity.name: Who can use an AI test maker?

acceptedAnswer.text: Teachers, students, trainers, HR teams, and businesses can all use it. Anyone who needs quick, reliable, and auto-scored assessments will benefit.

mainEntity.name: Can I create a test without coding?

acceptedAnswer.text: It’s used to make tests for schools, training, hiring, or fun quizzes. You can create, share, and grade tests online—fast and easy.

mainEntity.name: What file formats can I upload?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDF, and TXT, up to 100 pages or 50 MB per file on the free plan. You can also paste text, drop in a URL, or forms from other platform such as Jotform, Typeform, Google forms, etc. Mix sources if your test needs to cover more than one document.

mainEntity.name: Is the AI test generator free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Formester AI Test Generator is free to use. No credit card required to sign up, and you can generate and publish test on the free plan. Paid plans unlock custom branding, advanced integrations, and higher response limits.

mainEntity.name: How many questions can I generate from one upload?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can generate an unlimited number of questions

mainEntity.name: Can I edit the questions the AI generates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Rewrite any stem, swap a distractor, change a correct answer, adjust the points, or regenerate a single question without touching the rest. Nothing publishes until you hit publish.
Multiple choice, true or false, fill in the blank, short answer, matching, numeric, and open ended.

mainEntity.name: Does it generate answer keys and grading rules?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Every generated test ships with an answer key, points per question, and optional partial credit on multi-part items. Auto-grade the objective questions and grade short answers with AI-assisted review. Override any score and leave a note for the student.

mainEntity.name: How accurate are the questions the AI generates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every question is graded against the source you uploaded, flagged if it can't be answered from the material.

mainEntity.name: Can I set time limits for my test?

acceptedAnswer.text: Definitely. You can limit how long someone has to complete the test.

mainEntity.name: Does the AI also generate correct answers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. With Formester’s AI test generator, the tool not only creates questions but also suggests accurate test answers.

mainEntity.name: Can test takers pause and continue later?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, students can save their progress and continue later. Great for long tests or poor internet connections.

mainEntity.name: Can I preview my test before sharing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Before publishing, you can preview your AI generated test to see exactly how it looks for test takers.

mainEntity.name: Who owns the tests I create?

acceptedAnswer.text: You do. Formester does not train models on your uploads or your generated tests. You can delete a test, a source file, or an entire workspace at any time.

mainEntity.name: What is the best AI test generator for teachers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formester is one of the best. It creates tests with AI, auto-grades answers, supports multimedia, and is easy to use.

mainEntity.name: Which tool helps you create your own quiz?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formester’s AI quiz maker helps you build your own quiz fast. Just type a topic, and it generates questions, answers, and scoring.

mainEntity.name: What is the top test generator software?

acceptedAnswer.text: Formester ranks among the top test generator tools. It offers AI test generation, auto-scoring, offline support, and detailed analytics.

At a glance

Inputs and question types

The honest attribute list. No feature toggles buried in a pricing page.

What you can upload Source materials

PDF, DOCX, PPTX, TXT, pasted text, prompts, URLs, and YouTube lecture links. Up to 100 pages or 50 MB per file on the free plan. 500 pages on paid plans.

PDF DOCX PPTX TXT URL YouTube Prompt
Question types you get Output formats

Multiple choice, true or false, fill in the blank, short answer, matching, numeric, and open ended. Mix question types in a single test, set points per item, and pull the answer key out before you publish.

MCQ True or False Fill in the blank Short answer Matching Numeric Open ended
Languages Output

180+ languages including English, Spanish, French, Hindi, Arabic, Mandarin, Japanese, German, Portuguese, and Turkish.

Question quality

Tests that ship with usable items, not items you have to vet line by line.

When the AI drafts a test, it picks the right item type for each question, writes plausible distractors instead of obvious throwaways, and sets the answer key as it goes. Multiple choice gets four options where two are real contenders, not one correct plus three jokes. Short answer gets a clean acceptance pattern. True/false stays out of double-negative traps. These are the small calls a test designer normally makes by hand for every item.

Every draft lands in the Formester editor, never as a frozen output. Rewrite the stem, swap a distractor, change the difficulty, regenerate a single item, or override the answer key. The AI handles the obvious 80%; the editor is where the last 20% gets human judgment.

What the AI handles automatically

Five calls you don't have to make.

  • Plausible distractors on every multiple choice item, instead of obvious throwaways the test-taker eliminates on sight.
  • Answer key set as items are written, so you don't have to rebuild the key after editing the questions.
  • Difficulty mix across the test (easy / medium / hard) so the score curves the way a real test should.
  • Item-type variety across MCQ, true/false, short answer, and matching, instead of 20 multiple-choice items in a row.
  • Cueing words flagged ("always," "never," "all of the above") that telegraph the answer before the test-taker reads the options.

Why pick Formester

Why teachers and trainers pick Formester as their AI test generator.

Six things educators and L&D leads keep coming back for, sourced from how the product is actually used, not from a feature list.

AI test generator on the free plan

Generate a complete test from a prompt, a syllabus PDF, or a question list before you decide whether to pay. No credit card, no trial expiry, no watermark on the printed test.

Answer key set as items are written

The grader is built as the questions are. Edit a stem, swap a distractor, override the key inline. Scores compute on submit. No spreadsheet, no manual rubric, no rebuilding the answer sheet at midnight before class.

Item-type variety in one test

Multiple choice, true/false, short answer, and matching all coexist in the same test. The AI picks the right type for each question instead of defaulting to 20 multiple-choice items in a row.

Every draft is editable

The AI output is the first draft, never the final word. Rewrite a stem, regenerate a single item, change difficulty, swap a distractor, or pull from a template. Nothing freezes.

Score-based routing with conditional logic

Send the test-taker to remediation if they score below 60%, to a certificate if they pass, and to the next module if they ace it. Personal plan unlocks the full conditional engine.

Student data stays student data

Test responses are not used to train AI models, run advertising, or feed analytics. Written into our DPA, Section 4.4. GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. Encrypted at rest, TLS in transit, audit-ready on request.

Who uses Formester AI test generator

Every test has a job to do. Below is how Formester fits the jobs we see most.

Teachers and professors

Drop in the chapter you just taught. Walk out with a twenty-question midterm, Bloom's tagged and tied back to the page numbers you uploaded. Export to Google Forms, Canvas, or Moodle before the bell rings.

Browse our quiz templates

Corporate L&D and trainers

Upload the forty-page anti-harassment policy nobody reads. Get a fifteen-question compliance test that's actually written from the policy, not a generic template. Branch questions by job family, auto-score, and push the pass or fail straight into your LMS so HR doesn't have to chase anyone.

Browse our training form templates

Recruiters and hiring teams

Screen candidates with a role-specific skill test built from your JD or interview rubric. Grade short answers with AI-assisted review. Shortlist in one view.

Browse our employee skills assessment templates

Coaches and bootcamp operators

Drop the week's session notes. Get a ten-question check for understanding, shareable on Slack or WhatsApp, completion tracked live. You'll catch the two people who missed the same concept before next week's drill.

Students and self-learners

Paste a week of lecture notes. Get a practice test with explanations you can re-take, shuffle, and mark the questions you still miss. Free forever on the basic plan.

For developers

Your test results, ready for the AI you already use.

Every Formester test ships with a REST API and an MCP server, so scores don't stop at a CSV. Pipe results into your LMS. Stream item-level data into a teaching copilot. Nobody else on this list ships MCP.

MCP server

Plug Formester into Claude, ChatGPT, or any MCP-compatible model.

Claude ChatGPT Custom agents

Connect Formester to any MCP-compatible model and let it read your test results directly. Ask Claude "which questions tripped up the most students this term?", or have a custom agent group test-takers by score band and draft a remediation plan for the bottom quartile.

Privacy and data ownership

Your content is not used to train anyone's AI. Yours, ours, or theirs.

When you upload a PDF, paste a prompt, or generate a test, that content is used to generate your test and nothing else. Per Section 4.4 of our DPA, Formester does not use Customer Data for analytics, advertising, marketing, or product training. The Google Gemini integration we use to power AI features inherits the same boundary.

Encrypted in transit and at rest, hosted on Heroku and AWS, automated encrypted backups with a 90-day retention, and full data deletion on request. We are GDPR, UK GDPR, and CCPA compliant. We are not SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certified yet, and we will tell you so directly rather than dance around it.
